{{Quote|Beyond Tython, they settled first on Kalimahr, jewel of the Tython system, then Shikaakwa, the outlaw world, then on the forest planet Ska Gora, and on the moons of the Giants&mdash;Obri and Mawr&mdash;and even the outermost planet, cold Furies Gate.|[[Ketu]], of the non&ndash;Force-sensitive Tythans|<ref name="DotJ1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Mawr''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with seven [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that was located within the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region. Mawr and [[Obri]]&mdash;another gas giant of the [[Star system/Legends|star system]]&mdash;were collectively referred to by the settlers of the Tython system as "[[the Giants]]." More than thirty-six thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tythan|settlers]] of the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] colonized Mawr's moons. By [[25,793 BBY]], gas-[[Mining/Legends|mining]] facilities had also been established within the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the planet itself.

==Description==
Mawr was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]&ndash;type [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located within the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region,<ref name="DotJ0" /> at grid coordinates L-10.<ref name="EAOC" /> The planet occupied the tenth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around its [[Star/Legends|sun]], [[Tythos]], while seven [[Moon/Legends|moons]] rotated around the planet in turn. Mawr and [[Obri]]&mdash;the ninth planet of the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] and also a gas giant&mdash;were collectively referred to by the settlers of the Tython system as "[[the Giants]]."<ref name="DotJ0" />

==History==
When the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tythan|settlers]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]&mdash;<ref name="DotJ1" />the fifth planet of the system&mdash;<ref name="DotJ0" />[[Second migration|traveled]] to its neighboring worlds more than a [[Time/Legends|millennium]] after<ref name="DotJ1" /> the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[36,453 BBY]],<ref name="Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref> they colonized the moons of Mawr.<ref name="DotJ0" /> By [[25,793 BBY]],<ref name="Void" /> gas-[[Mining/Legends|mining]] facilities within the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] had also been established.<ref name="DotJ0" /> In that year,<ref name="Void" /> [[Ketu]]&mdash;a [[Je'daii Temple Master|Temple Master]] of the mystic [[Je'daii Order]]&mdash;told the [[Padawan (Je'daii)|Padawan]] learners [[Harun]] and [[Resi]] the history of the Tython system, and mentioned the colonization of Mawr's natural [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]], amid other events.<ref name="DotJ1" />

When the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] [[Invasion of the Tython system|Invaded]] the Tython system, they attacked Mawr and [[Obri]]'s moons, following the initial attack on [[Furies Gate]]. After capturing the giants and enslaving the inhabitants, they directed the attack against Tython, but were driven back to [[Ska Gora]].

==Behind the scenes==
Mawr was first pictured in the entry for Tython in [[The Holonet]] feature of the official website for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''&mdash;a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]]. The gas giant was depicted in a schematic of the Tython system. Since its establishment in [[2008]], ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} website has gone through a number of changes, resulting in the removal of some of the features and images that were originally located there, including the aforementioned schematic. Mawr's name and additional information on it were provided in ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0]]'', a preview issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' series of [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]]. The issue was published on [[February 1]], [[2012]] and was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Jan Duursema]]. The planet was also mentioned in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|first]] issue of the series, which was published on [[February 15]] of the same year.
